title.narrative: Enhancing Market Access for Fresh Produce through Certification

description.narrative: The stringent international standards and dynamic market requirements remain an increasing impediment to export market access. The volume of horticulture exports to the EU market dropped by 30 per cent from 4,143 tons in the year 2014 to 3672 tons in the year 2015. Specifically, the volume of fresh vegetables exports from Kenya reduced by 7% compared to 2014. This drop is partly attributed to inadequate skills in compliance and low capacity in quality management by small scale farmers to comply with stringent market requirements, weak traceability system and lack of information on new emerging markets.Budget: US$ 485,000?
